'''Abyssin''' was the written [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It corresponded to a [[Abyssin (language)|spoken language of the same name]] and was written using a simple set of hieroglyphics.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
